# Deskly AI Assist — Add-on Terms

*Deskly Inc. (fictional vendor). Version 2.1, effective 1 September 2026. Sent to Samir Haddad with a
quote on 14 October 2026. These terms supplement the Deskly Master Subscription Agreement ("MSA").
Capitalised terms not defined here have the meaning given in the MSA.*

## 1. The add-on

1.1 **AI Assist** adds the following features to the Customer's Deskly workspace: (a) **Triage** —
suggested category, priority, language and sentiment for incoming tickets; (b) **Draft replies** —
suggested replies drafted from the ticket, the Customer's saved replies and the Customer's knowledge
base; (c) **Translate** — translation of incoming messages and drafts; (d) **Summaries** of long
threads; and (e) **Autopilot** (optional) — automatic sending of replies to tickets that AI Assist
classifies as "high confidence".

1.2 Autopilot is off by default and may be switched on by any workspace Administrator for any view or
category.

## 2. Pricing

2.1 AI Assist is priced at **US$ 29 per agent seat per month**, billed annually, for all agent seats in
the workspace, plus **US$ 0.90 per Autopilot resolution**.

2.2 Deskly may change AI Assist pricing on 30 days' notice. Usage-based fees are calculated by Deskly's
systems and are final.

## 3. Customer Content and AI

3.1 To provide AI Assist, Deskly sends ticket content, including personal data in tickets ("Customer
Content"), to the AI service providers listed in Annex 1.

3.2 **Service improvement.** Deskly may use Customer Content and Outputs, in de-identified form, to
develop and improve Deskly's products and services, **including to train and evaluate machine-learning
models**. Customer may opt out by written notice to privacy@deskly.example; the opt-out applies from
30 days after receipt.

3.3 Deskly's AI service providers do not use Customer Content to train their general models.

3.4 **Retention.** Prompts and Outputs are retained for 30 days for abuse monitoring and
troubleshooting, and in Deskly's analytics store for **24 months**. On termination of the MSA,
Customer Content is deleted within 90 days, except backups, which are overwritten within a further
180 days.

## 4. Outputs

4.1 Outputs are generated automatically and may be inaccurate, incomplete or inappropriate. **Customer
is solely responsible for reviewing Outputs before they are sent**, and for any Output sent by
Autopilot.

4.2 AI Assist is provided "as is". Deskly makes no warranty that Outputs will be accurate, and Section 9
(Indemnities) of the MSA does not apply to Outputs.

4.3 Deskly's total liability arising from AI Assist is limited to the AI Assist fees paid in the
**three months** before the claim.

## 5. Data location and transfers

5.1 Customer Content is stored in the region selected for the workspace (Harbor & Pine: **US**).
AI processing may take place in the United States and the European Union.

5.2 Deskly will transfer personal data outside the Customer's country only in accordance with the
Data Processing Addendum (DPA) of the MSA.

## 6. Sub-processors

6.1 Deskly may add or replace AI sub-processors by updating Annex 1 on its website. Customer may
subscribe to email notification. If Customer objects within 15 days, Customer's sole remedy is to stop
using AI Assist.

## 7. Customer responsibilities

7.1 Customer will not use AI Assist to make decisions that produce legal or similarly significant
effects on individuals without human review.

7.2 Customer is responsible for providing any notices to, and obtaining any consents from, its end
customers that are required for processing their personal data with AI Assist.

## 8. Term

8.1 AI Assist runs co-terminously with the MSA (Harbor & Pine renewal: 31 January 2027) and renews with
it. Customer may remove AI Assist at renewal on 30 days' written notice.

---

## Annex 1 — AI sub-processors (as of 1 September 2026)

| Sub-processor | Purpose | Location |
|---|---|---|
| A foundation-model provider (named in the trust portal, login required) | Draft replies, summaries, triage | United States |
| CloudCompute Inc. | Hosting of AI Assist services | United States, Ireland |
| LangBridge Ltd. | Machine translation | Ireland |
| QualityOps Services | Human review of flagged Outputs for quality and abuse | Philippines |
